item.title: Selling Insider Information
item.description:
So apparently the self dealing disaster of an administration is selling insider information now. Guess the strategy continues to be, do something illegal and unethical as hell, mine it for all it’s worth to enrich yourself, and dare the pathetically weak/lacky congress/legal system to stop you. 😡

Truth Social is selling posts at a premium, and Wall Street is buying. Trump Media & Technology Group (TMTG), the parent company of Truth Social, announced last week that it was rolling out a paid “Truth API” feed with real-time posts from 10 of the biggest political accounts on the platform, including President Trump. The feed gives traders early access to the president’s market-moving posts, giving them a leg up on markets. Source: Morning Brew
